description: Compute current weighted course grade from category weights and scores (percent, fractions like 17/20 or lists) and calculate the exact score required on the final exam for a target grade (and A/B/C/D table). Runs on our server, files are deleted right after the call, nothing stored. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €9/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.001/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/grade-calculator.

categories.description: One category per line (or JSON array): Name | weight | score

finalWeight.description: Weight of the final exam (optional if an empty-score line exists)

mode.description: current (weighted grade) or final (score needed on final)

name: grade_calculator
title: Grade Calculator API - weighted course grade and score needed on final exam
